why_the_three_weeks_looked_good: The same three weeks were reused across many candidate, branch, confirmation, target and stop decisions. They therefore became an adaptive training set rather than an independent validation set.

The selected v18 observations contained 8 wins in 15 trades while the full 2022-2024 ledger contained 127 wins in 663 trades. Under hypergeometric sampling from the long ledger, the probability of at least 8 wins in 15 trades is approximately 0.2846 percent.

Monday-week resampling of the v18 long ledger ranked the profitable 2022 selected week first among 157 weeks and the profitable 2024 selected week in approximately the top 3.2 percent. The selected three-week combination was approximately in the upper 0.09 percent of available combinations.
The fixed-week 15-trade mean log-return confidence interval included zero, so the screen never established a stable positive expectation despite a high point estimate.

Causal entry-time features available in the long ledger (auction horizon, ATR, volume ratio, flow, reward-to-risk, time and path) did not produce stable forward classification: year-forward AUC stayed near 0.5 and top-score subsets retained negative mean R. The good fixed weeks were not a reliably identifiable regime.

v18.conclusion: narrow failed-boundary invalidation produced catastrophic long-run false reversals

v10.conclusion: the accepted-breakout-failure family remains negative even with the older wider invalidation; the family, not only the v18 stop, is invalid

retired_family: accepted-breakout-failure reversal and all filter-salvage variants derived from it

research_process_change.candidate_selection: baseline first; otherwise at most one predeclared single-layer ablation that independently passes every development requirement
research_process_change.holdout_access: only a passing frozen development variant may be evaluated once
prohibited: further use of the old three weeks to choose hypotheses, filters, stops or targets
second-stage tuning after seeing the 2025 holdout
declaring a sparse or single-trade positive ablation a structural path

next_candidate_reason: It is a distinct completed-session liquidity mechanism evaluated first on a broad block, not a parameter repair of the retired accepted-breakout-failure family.
